lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 25 to 30 high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible, arranged in four distinct horizontal rows. The clusters exhibit a staggered spatial distribution where nodes in adjacent rows are offset by approximately 50% of their inter-nodal distance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows at near-orthogonal angles, creating a grid-like mesh where the high-luminance blobs act as vertex nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge (carina) is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank. It is defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition, with higher luminance values on the dorsal side of the ridge and lower luminance/shadow values on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of faint, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily near the anterior base and the lower posterior margin of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch-like indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, approximately one-third of the way up from the base. A horizontal linear feature, possibly a skin fold or healed trauma, is visible at the junction of the dorsal fin and the main body mass.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) visible in the ventral water column, with one specimen clearly positioned near the pelvic fin region.
